rows.label: qst640404_msg0001
rows.name: And you are...?

rows.label: qst640404_msg0002
rows.name:
I see... So Feline and the
others were worried...

rows.label: qst640404_msg0003
rows.name: Then could we borrow your strength?

rows.label: qst640404_msg0004
rows.name:
Right now, the Geothermal Mining Plant
isn't operating normally because the
machinery is malfunctioning.

rows.label: qst640404_msg0005
rows.name:
That's why I sent Gisisi and
Olek to run repairs on the
higher floors of the facility...

rows.label: qst640404_msg0006
rows.name:
I sent Salaf to collect the materials
needed for repairs.

rows.label: qst640404_msg0007
rows.name:
...However, none of the
three's come back yet.

rows.label: qst640404_msg0008
rows.name:
Something must have happened. I'd like
you to find all three and help with
the repairs...

rows.label: qst640404_msg0009
rows.name: Thank you.

rows.label: qst640404_msg0010
rows.name:
...Come to think of it, have you been
to the second floor of the Geothermal
Mining Plant?

rows.label: qst640404_msg0011
rows.name:
You can get there by taking
a gondola from the Shamayim
Plant back in town.

rows.label: qst640404_msg0012
rows.name:
Outsiders can't enter the plant
itself... Sorry, but you'll have to
take the long way around.

rows.label: qst640404_msg0013
rows.name: Thank you in advance.

rows.label: qst640404_msg0101
rows.name:
Thank you. Thanks to you, the plant is
back in operation.

rows.label: qst640404_msg0102
rows.name: Now we can go home for a while.

rows.label: qst640404_msg0103
rows.name:
I must express gratitude to
you, and to our daughters.

rows.label: qst640404_msg0104
rows.name:
This is presumptuous, but may I ask
one more favor?

rows.label: qst640404_msg0105
rows.name:
Could you tell our four daughters,
Feline and the others, that we'll be
home soon?

rows.label: qst640404_msg0106
rows.name:
They must be worried, so I want them
to know as soon as possible...

rows.label: qst640404_msg0107
rows.name: Thank you.
